from pathlib import Path
from datetime import datetime, timezone
import hashlib, json, re, shlex, sys, time
started = datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat()
timer = time.monotonic()

root = Path(payload['root'])

inputs = list(manifest['input_files_sha256'])
for action in payload['prior']:
    if 'ALL_LISTED_INPUT_FILES' in action.get('files_read', []):
        action['files_read'] = [str(root / 'evaluation-input.json')] + [str(root / name) for name in inputs]
checks = {}
actual_hashes = {}
for name, expected in manifest['input_files_sha256'].items():
    actual_hashes[name] = hashlib.sha256((root / name).read_bytes()).hexdigest()
    assert actual_hashes[name] == expected, name
checks['all_24_input_hashes_match'] = len(actual_hashes) == 24
assert checks['all_24_input_hashes_match']
skill_hash = hashlib.sha256(Path(payload['skill']).read_bytes()).hexdigest()
assert skill_hash == manifest['skill_inputs_sha256'][payload['skill']]
checks['selected_skill_hash_matches'] = True
selection = json.loads((root / 'selection.json').read_text())
assert len(selection['selected']) == 4
assert sum(bool(r.get('outputs')) for r in selection['receipts']) == 1
assert sum(bool(r.get('reason')) for r in selection['receipts']) == 2
checks['identity_accounting'] = {'selected':4,'reviewed':4,'output_linked':1,'justified_no_change':2}
question_rows = [line for line in (root / 'tasks/questions.md').read_text().splitlines() if line.startswith('| KQ-')]
answered = [line.split('|')[1].strip() for line in question_rows if line.split('|')[8].strip()]
assert answered == ['KQ-01', 'KQ-10', 'KQ-11'], answered
assert len(question_rows) == 12
checks['question_accounting'] = {'total':12,'answered':answered,'unanswered':9}
allowed = set(inputs)
links = re.findall(r'\]\(([^)]+)\)', payload['response'])
for target in links:
    assert target.startswith('../'), target
    relative = target[3:].split('#')[0]
    assert relative in allowed, target
    assert (root / relative).is_file(), target
checks['report_links_resolve_within_listed_inputs'] = len(links)
out = root / 'outputs'
out.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
response_path = out / 'response.md'
actions_path = out / 'actions.json'
response_path.write_text(payload['response'])
assert response_path.read_text() == payload['response']
checks['response_round_trip'] = True
action = {
    'sequence':6,
    'tool':'functions.exec -> tools.exec_command',
    'command_argv':sys.orig_argv,
    'command_reconstructed':shlex.join(sys.orig_argv),
    'started_at':started,
    'finished_at':datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(),
    'elapsed_seconds':time.monotonic()-timer,
    'files_read':[str(root / 'evaluation-input.json')]+[str(root / name) for name in inputs]+[payload['skill'],str(response_path),str(actions_path)],
    'files_written':[str(response_path),str(actions_path)],
    'result':checks,
    'exit_code':0
}
log = {
    'schema_version':1,
    'case_id':manifest['case_id'],
    'synthetic':True,
    'scope':'Read-only assessment of listed fixture inputs. Only requested outputs were written.',
    'requested_worker':{'model':'luna','reasoning':'max','source':'tasks/checkpoint.json'},
    'observed_settings':{'model':'UNKNOWN','reasoning':'UNKNOWN','client':'UNKNOWN','dispatch':None},
    'actual_files_read':list(dict.fromkeys([str(root / 'evaluation-input.json'),payload['skill']]+[str(root / name) for name in inputs]+[str(response_path),str(actions_path)])),
    'actual_files_written':[str(response_path),str(actions_path)],
    'actions':payload['prior']+[action],
    'checks':checks,
    'input_sha256_observed':actual_hashes,
    'skill_sha256_observed':skill_hash,
    'material_failures':[],
    'limits':['Synthetic fixture evidence does not establish business behavior.','No business transitions, network calls, external model runners, or subagents were used.','No self-grading was performed.','Earlier action start timestamps were unavailable. Actual tool elapsed times were retained.','Observed worker model, reasoning and client were unavailable.'],
    'completed_at':datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat()
}
actions_path.write_text(json.dumps(log, indent=2)+'\n')
assert json.loads(actions_path.read_text()) == log
print(json.dumps({'outputs':[str(response_path),str(actions_path)],'checks':checks,'input_changes':0,'elapsed_seconds':time.monotonic()-timer}))
